create.name: Kansas Zen Center
create.bio:
Kansas Zen Center has been part of the Kwan Um School of Zen in Lawrence, Kansas, since 1978, when a small group of Zen Master Seung Sahn's students, among them Judy Roitman and Stan Lombardo, set it up. Seung Sahn went on to visit every year for fourteen years, and the centre has since produced an unusual number of the school's authorised teachers in the Americas. Today its retreats and interviews are led by teachers including Dennis Duermeier, JDPSN, and Zen Master Bon Hae (Judy Roitman).

Practice is held in a house at the north end of Laura Avenue and most sessions can also be joined on Zoom: early-morning bows, chanting and sitting on weekdays and Saturdays, Wednesday evening special chanting, and a Sunday morning programme with a short talk and questions, preceded by an orientation for first-time visitors and a Dharma School for children. On Thursday evenings a second group sits in person in Kansas City, Missouri, at a Unity church near the Country Club Plaza. Two-day weekend retreats run most months, with a seven-day retreat each January, and the centre also runs study courses, a book club and an open library of practice notes and translations.

courses.title: November 2-day retreat
courses.description: A weekend retreat with Zen Master Bon Hae (Judy Roitman), joinable in person or on Zoom. The centre describes its retreats as fairly intensive and suited to people with some meditation experience.
courses.price: $120, contact us if you need the fee reduced or waived

courses.title: January 7 day retreat
courses.description: The centre's week-long in-person winter retreat, led by Dennis Duermeier JDPSN. Part stays of five days or fewer are possible at a daily rate.
courses.price: $350 for 6 or 7 days; $60/day for 5 or fewer days

courses.title: February 2-day retreat
courses.description: A hybrid weekend retreat led by Zen Master Bon Hae (Judy Roitman), with registration opening in late January.
courses.price: $120, contact us if you need the fee reduced or waived

free_resources.title: Practice schedule (in person and on Zoom)
free_resources.description: The weekly round of bows, chanting and sitting, most of it hybrid, with a Sunday talk and questions and a newcomers' orientation before it.

free_resources.title: Resources
free_resources.description: A free library of practice manuals, the chanting book with word-for-word translations, and notes by the centre's teachers on the Heart Sutra, the Hsin Hsin Ming, Nagarjuna and the temple rules.
